versionHint: Saves the current model and records it as a new version with your note.
importText: The current diagram will be replaced. It is saved as a draft automatically; click Save to create a version.
importFailed: The file could not be imported as BPMN 2.0
unsavedText: Your changes to the model will be lost.
selectElement: Select an element to see its properties.
labelsHint: Labels are stored in English and Arabic. Editing on the canvas changes the label of the current language.
linkedProcessHint: Drill down from this step into another process of the repository.
noObjects: Nothing found — add it to the library first

rules.NO_START_EVENT: The process has no start event.
rules.NO_END_EVENT: The process has no end event.
rules.UNCONNECTED_ELEMENT: Element is not connected to the flow.
rules.MISSING_INCOMING: Element has no incoming sequence flow.
rules.MISSING_OUTGOING: Element has no outgoing sequence flow.
rules.GATEWAY_NOT_BRANCHING: Gateway neither splits nor joins the flow.
rules.CALL_ACTIVITY_UNLINKED: Call activity is not linked to a process.

saveHint: Creates a new version with your change note. Your edits are also saved automatically as a draft.
restoreText: The model of this version becomes the working model and the new version {{next}}. No version is deleted; unsaved canvas changes are replaced.

description.hint: Shown when staff click the step in the Knowledge Portal.

commentsAll: All comments of the process. Select a step to see and add comments on it.

stepKind.label: Step kind
stepKind.hint: Approval steps are coloured as approvals. Automatic: a user task whose English label starts with Review, Approve, Endorse or Confirm.
